headline: Stable quarter, Fleur Hotels restructuring remains key

highlights: The company is proceeding with a demerger scheme that will split Lemon Tree Hotels into a pure-play, asset-light brand targeting 70-75% steady-state EBITDA margins, and Fleur Hotels, which will now be a separate, growth-oriented listed hotel ownership platform.
Retain BUY with an unchanged TP of INR 151, based on 22x Sep’27E EV/EBITDA.

Stable quarter; demand outlook improves LEMONTRE reported Q2FY27 consolidated revenue of INR 3.6bn (up 18% YoY), in line with I-Sec estimate, as portfolio ARRs grew 8% YoY (including Aurika) amid a pickup in demand following reduced geopolitical tensions.
Occupancy for the quarter was up 633bps YoY at 76.1%, translating into a RevPAR of INR 5,137, which was up 18% YoY.
valuation: The company is proceeding with a demerger scheme that will split Lemon Tree Hotels into a pure-play, asset-light brand targeting 70-75% steady-state EBITDA margins, and Fleur Hotels, which will now be a separate, growth-oriented listed hotel ownership platform.
Retain BUY with an unchanged TP of INR 151, based on 22x Sep’27E EV/EBITDA.

Focus remains on Fleur Hotels restructuring plans The company is proceeding with a demerger scheme that will split Lemon Tree Hotels into a pure-play, asset-light brand targeting 70-75% steady-state EBITDA margins, and Fleur Hotels SPV, which will be a separate, growth- oriented listed hotel ownership platform.
